verdict.rationale: Kit documents a public V4 API for third-party developers and account automation. It covers authentication with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE, refresh, revocation) plus API keys, cursor pagination, bulk and async processing, and signed webhooks with retries. Concrete endpoints cover broadcasts, stats, custom fields and accounts, and an llms.txt is live for agent consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.
